description:
Build your own AI assistant that can actually take action—not just answer questions. In this step-by-step tutorial, you’ll learn how to set up OpenClaw using Hostinger’s managed OpenClaw plan at https://hostinger.com/startopenclaw where you can use the coupon code STARTOPENCLAW for an extra discount. You’ll see how to connect OpenClaw to Telegram, and start using it to automate real tasks like summarizing AI news, monitoring YouTube channels, and more.

OpenClaw goes beyond traditional AI tools by allowing your assistant to interact with services, run workflows, and send you updates automatically. And with Hostinger’s 1-click setup, you can get started without dealing with server configuration, API keys, or complex installations. By the end of this video, you’ll have your own AI assistant up and running, with a clear understanding of how to use it safely and effectively.

You’ll learn:
• What makes OpenClaw different from tools like ChatGPT
• How to set up OpenClaw with zero technical
